title: A Mobilous Update ⚡
excerpt: Our biggest mobile-focused update yet, with a redesigned mobile experience, new reporting system, improved performance, Block Mode fixes, FR+ improvements, a return of Scrolling Frame, and tons of quality-of-life changes.
body: This is one of the biggest Friends Remover updates yet! We completely improved the mobile experience, brought back the classic Scrolling Frame, improved performance, fixed major Block Mode issues, introduced a new reporting system, rebuilt how FR+ activation works, and made countless improvements across the extension. Mobile users should notice significantly smoother animations, better navigation, improved settings, and less lag overall. We also made major changes to our backend and monitoring systems to reduce unnecessary Roblox API requests and improve reliability.

added.moreInfo: Users can now report bad users directly from their friends list while using Compact View. After submitting a report, the reported friend is automatically removed and added to Unfriend History. Free users can submit up to 5 reports per Roblox account per day, while FR+ users can submit up to 15 reports per day. Reports are sent for review, with AI-assisted review followed by manual moderation.
Users can now pin flagged users as long as they are not flagged for child-predator-related reasons. Other flagged categories will still display warnings but will not prevent pinning.
Classic Friends List users now have a Friends Detail view that mirrors the Compact Viewer experience.
Added filters that let users see how friends were removed from their account.
Friends list filter selections are now saved locally.
Added a menu button that lets users quickly switch between Compact View and the classic Friends List directly in the popup.
Mobile users can now choose between swipe navigation and arrow navigation for Compact View in the popup.
Dark Mode has returned to Friends Remover with a fresh, cleaner appearance for the perfect return.
The classic Scrolling Frame has returned as an optional viewer. It includes performance improvements such as pagination and reduced loading demands.

added.text: Suspended, Banned, or Deleted Account Detection
added.moreInfo: A custom popup error screen now appears when your Roblox account is suspended, banned, or deleted.
The removal screen now has larger profile pictures, improved spacing, a progress bar, and an estimated completion time.

added.text: Pinned and Trusted User Name Effect
added.moreInfo: Added a special shimmer effect to pinned or trusted users' names in Compact View.
FR+ is now detected through the FR+ role in the Friends Remover group.
Users can now receive a notification when they are granted FR+ through the group system.

Updated all removal speeds and removed the Quick removal speed option. Ultra Quick at 30ms and Fast at 100ms are available for FR+ users, while free users receive Normal at 300ms, Slow at 750ms, and Very Slow at 1500ms.

removed.moreInfo: The old report settings system has been removed because reporting is now handled directly through the new reporting system.
Removed the old Import and Export system from Settings.
Removed the unused update notification system that was originally intended to make older Friends Remover versions unsupported.
Removed the unused GitHub update polling system from background.js.
Removed dynamic polling for all of our background friend-removal options. Each one now runs on its own fixed interval.
Removed the empty Advanced tab from mobile Settings until there are actual advanced options to display.
Removed the update carousel from the mobile Settings interface.
Removed the old FR+ setup process. Users can now activate FR+ through supported Roblox methods such as group rank and game pass, not our database.
Automatically removing flagged users has been temporarily disabled while the new Friends Remover database is being built.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed a major issue where Block Mode was completely non-functional because the wrong Roblox API was being used.
Fixed Block Mode occasionally losing its permanent blue theme.
Fixed mobile users sometimes opening the desktop Settings interface.
Scheduled users are now automatically removed from the popup live when appropriate.
Fixed the navigation arrows in Unfriend History being positioned too far away.
Fixed areas of the extension that incorrectly continued displaying 'Removal' when Block Mode was enabled.
Fixed duplicate notifications for pinned friend removals when Auto Re-add is enabled.
Notify if a Friend Removes You no longer sends a notification when Auto Re-add is enabled.
When FR+ is lost, all FR+ features now disable properly.
Reduced the performance cost of popup animations so mobile users can use them smoothly without needing to disable animations.

improved.moreInfo: Major improvements were made throughout the mobile popup, including navigation, settings, animations, spacing, performance, and responsiveness.
We are finally building our own database instead of relying on the previous flagged-user system.
Flagged statuses now look like normal status indicators and their tooltips have been updated to match the extension.
When a flagged user is pinned, their flagged badge is removed from the current user's view so their normal status is displayed. They will still remain flagged for other users.
Suggest Pins is now automatically enabled and is no longer optional.
Warn Bad Players is now automatically enabled and is no longer optional.

Removed routine FR+ worker membership checks, including GET /fr_plus, DELETE /fr_plus, popup startup checks, Settings startup checks, feature-lock checks, removal-speed checks, history checks, scheduling checks, and polling checks.
FR+ membership is now verified directly through Roblox's game-pass, subscription, and group systems.
Friends Remover is now again available as a one-time payment of $1.15 due to the lack of sales.
Pinned removals now use one notification when Auto Re-add is enabled. Notify if a Friend Removes You will only notify when Auto Re-add is disabled.
The popup header is now slightly larger and the header animation has been brought back.
The returning Scrolling Frame includes performance improvements such as 50 friends per page and additional optimizations to reduce lag.
Updated leftover debug intervals that were unnecessarily hammering Roblox's API.
Changed the ban-status check interval from 30 seconds to 6 minutes.
Changed the friend-request check interval from 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Changed the banned-friend monitor interval from 30 seconds to 3 minutes.
Ban, inactive, pinned, friend-request, external-removal, and flagged-user background checks are now throttled so they do not run at the same time and compete for Roblox API requests.
Manual removal and blocking actions still run immediately and can skip ahead of background checks.
checkAndJoinGroup() now runs from the popup instead of running as a background process.
Updated console logging throughout the extension to make debugging information easier to read.
Users can now switch between Compact View and the classic Friends List directly from the popup menu.
Mobile users can now choose between swipe navigation and arrow-based navigation.
Removal speeds are faster overall. FR+ users receive Ultra Quick at 30ms and Fast at 100ms, while free users receive Normal at 300ms, Slow at 750ms, and Very Slow at 1500ms.
Block Mode now understands Roblox's 1,000 blocked-user limit and lets users know when they reach the limit.
Popup animations were optimized to reduce CPU and rendering demands on mobile devices.
Classic Friends List users now get a detailed friend interface similar to Compact View.
Added filtering options to make large removal histories easier to navigate.
Filter selections are now remembered locally.
The popup now automatically removes scheduled users from the displayed list live as their scheduled removal occurs.
Reduced unnecessary work and expensive animations throughout the mobile interface for a significantly smoother experience.
